metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1924 · Sherlock Jr.
metas.description: A film projectionist longs to be a detective, and puts his meagre skills to work when he is framed by a rival for stealing his girlfriend's father's pocketwatch.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1949 · White Heat
metas.description: A psychopathic criminal with a mother complex makes a daring break from prison and leads his old gang in a chemical plant payroll heist.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1923 · Safety Last!
metas.description: A boy leaves his small country town and heads to the big city to get a job. As soon as he makes it big his sweetheart will join him and marry him. His enthusiasm to get ahead leads to some interesting adventures.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1938 · The Adventures of Robin Hood
metas.description: When Prince John and the Norman Lords begin oppressing the Saxon masses in King Richard's absence in 1190s England, a Saxon lord fights back as the outlaw leader of a resistance movement.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1948 · Key Largo
metas.description: A drifter visits the family hotel of a war buddy who was killed in action only to find that a Chicago mobster and his gang have taken over the place. As a hurricane approaches, a confrontation ensues.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1932 · Scarface
metas.description: An ambitious and nearly insane violent gangster climbs the ladder of success in the mob, but his weaknesses prove to be his downfall.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1940 · Foreign Correspondent
metas.description: On the eve of World War II, a young American reporter tries to expose enemy agents in London.
